source: 02 · [Name] and the Big-Kid List — APPROVED v2.docx
back_blurb: Shoes, coat, cup, hands… and the potty. [Name]'s big-kid list lives on the fridge, one try at a time. Some days nothing comes, some days it's oops, and that's fine. A gentle potty story, with the words for the real moment inside.
honesty_line: Illustrated from [Name]'s photo and checked by a person before print.
outfit: rust jumper and star-print trousers with white trainers
cover_art: [Name] in the story's key scene from spread 1 — face large and front-on; upper third calm for the title. Kitchen of a UK terrace. [Name] points at the list on the fridge; [Carer] crouches beside

title_page.spot: Small spot of the list. No child on this page.

anchor.description: Fridge list drawn on spreads 1, 2, 6, 9 and 12 with 0, 1, 4, 5 and 5 ticks. The fifth tick lands on spread 9, after an empty sit, never after a wee. [Object] on every other spread. Child's outfit fixed.

must_not_show: unhappy adult face at the accident
toilet humour. The child is never drawn using the potty mid-wee

characters.name: Fridge list
characters.description: Paper list on a fridge with five simple picture icons: shoes, coat, cup, hands, potty. Blank ticks (no ticks filled). Two clear views on a plain blank background. No child, no letters beyond simple icons.

spreads.text: This is [Name]'s big-kid list. It lives on the fridge. Shoes. Coat. Cup. Hands. Potty. "Big-kid things to try," says [Carer]. "One at a time."
spreads.setting: Kitchen of a UK terrace. [Name] points at the list on the fridge
spreads.art: Kitchen of a UK terrace. [Name] points at the list on the fridge; [Carer] crouches beside
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above the fridge — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Shoes first. [Name] pulls them on. Left foot in the right shoe. Wobble, wobble! [Name] laughs and swaps them. Now they fit. One more tick on the big-kid list.
spreads.setting: Hall by the front door, coat pegs and wellies. [Name] on the bottom stair, shoes on the wrong feet, laughing
spreads.art: Hall by the front door, coat pegs and wellies. [Name] on the bottom stair, shoes on the wrong feet, laughing
spreads.anchor: List through the kitchen door, 1 tick
spreads.calm_zone_note: Above the coat pegs — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Coat next. The zip is tricky. [Carer] holds the bottom. [Name] pulls up, up, up. Zzzip! One more tick on the big-kid list.
spreads.setting: Hall. [Carer] holds the bottom of the zip
spreads.art: Hall. [Carer] holds the bottom of the zip; [Name] pulls it up, chin tucked, concentrating
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper left wall — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Then the cup. No lid! Slurp. Splosh. A little spill. [Name] wipes it with a cloth. Slurp again. One more tick on the big-kid list.
spreads.setting: Kitchen table. [Name] drinks from an open cup, a small spill, cloth in the other hand
spreads.art: Kitchen table. [Name] drinks from an open cup, a small spill, cloth in the other hand
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Then hands. Soap. Bubbles. Rub, rub, rub. [Name] sings the hand-washing song right to the end. One more tick on the big-kid list.
spreads.setting: Bathroom basin with a step stool. [Name] rubs soapy hands, mouth open, singing
spreads.art: Bathroom basin with a step stool. [Name] rubs soapy hands, mouth open, singing
spreads.calm_zone_note: Tiled wall, upper left — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Last on the list is the potty. [Name] looks at it. "Not today." "That's fine," says [Carer]. "We can try another time. It's your turn to choose."
spreads.setting: Bathroom. [Name] looks at a blue potty by the door, relaxed
spreads.art: Bathroom. [Name] looks at a blue potty by the door, relaxed; [Carer] kneels, smiling
spreads.anchor: List seen through the door, 4 ticks
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Another day, [Name] sits on the potty. Clothes on. Just to see. [Object] stays close beside [Name]. "Comfy?" asks [Carer]. [Name] nods.
spreads.setting: [Name] sits fully dressed on the potty, curious
spreads.art: [Name] sits fully dressed on the potty, curious; [Object] close beside (drawn to suit the object: on the floor, in a lap, over a shoulder)
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: "I need a wee!" says [Name]. [Carer] smiles. "You noticed! That's the big-kid part." Off they go to the potty together.
spreads.setting: Living room. [Name] stops playing, hand up, alert face
spreads.art: Living room. [Name] stops playing, hand up, alert face; [Carer] smiles
spreads.calm_zone_note: Window area — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Name] sits and waits. And waits. Nothing comes. "Sitting counts," says [Carer]. Wash hands. And one more tick on the big-kid list.
spreads.setting: Kitchen, just after handwashing (hands still a little damp, towel nearby). [Name] reaches up and adds a tick to the fridge list
spreads.art: Kitchen, just after handwashing (hands still a little damp, towel nearby). [Name] reaches up and adds a tick to the fridge list; [Carer] holds it steady. The potty itself is not shown
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above the fridge — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Oh! A wet patch, right in the middle of playing. "Oops," says [Name]. "Oops is fine," says [Carer]. "Clean clothes. Carry on." So [Name] carries on.
spreads.setting: Living-room play mat. A small darker patch on the trousers only, not the focus
spreads.art: Living-room play mat. A small darker patch on the trousers only, not the focus; [Name] neutral, says oops; [Carer] calm, holding clean clothes
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper left — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Some days, nothing comes. Some days… tinkle, tinkle! A wee in the potty! [Name] and [Carer] wash hands and sing the song together, loud.
spreads.setting: Bathroom basin. [Name] and [Carer] wash hands together, both singing loud, big smiles. The potty itself is not shown
spreads.art: Bathroom basin. [Name] and [Carer] wash hands together, both singing loud, big smiles. The potty itself is not shown
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: [Name] counts the ticks. One, two, three, four, five! [Carer] holds the list steady. "What's next?" asks [Carer]. "Big-kid pants!" says [Name].
spreads.setting: Kitchen. [Name] counts on fingers in front of the list
spreads.art: Kitchen. [Name] counts on fingers in front of the list; [Carer] holds it steady
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper right — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: Into the bag go spare pants and spare trousers. "Just in case," says [Carer]. "Oops is fine at [Place] too."
spreads.setting: Bedroom. [Name] packs spare pants and trousers into a small day bag that [Carer] holds open
spreads.art: Bedroom. [Name] packs spare pants and trousers into a small day bag that [Carer] holds open
spreads.calm_zone_note: Upper — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

spreads.text: This morning at [Place]. [Name] waves to [Carer]. Coat on the peg. Spare pants in the bag. [Name] is ready.
spreads.setting: Entrance of [Place], two set variants: a nursery (coat pegs) or a childminder's home (hooks by the door). [Name] hangs a coat, bag on back, waving
spreads.art: Entrance of [Place], two set variants: a nursery (coat pegs) or a childminder's home (hooks by the door). [Name] hangs a coat, bag on back, waving; [Carer]'s hand at the frame edge
spreads.calm_zone_note: Wall above the pegs or hooks — keep low-detail; story text sits there.

parent_spread.you_could_say: "Sitting counts. Oops is fine. We can try another time."
parent_spread.in_real_life: Make a picture list together with whatever [Name] is trying right now, and keep spare clothes in the bag.
parent_spread.read_it_again: Read it a few nights in a row, and again whenever [Name] asks.
